evals.prompt: I need my resume reformatted for an account executive role. I have 8 years of experience across three software companies. Here are my roles and dates: Company A, Account Executive, 2021-2024; Company B, Senior Account Manager, 2018-2021; Company C, Sales Associate, 2016-2018. Target job description attached.
evals.expected_output: Asks for or confirms metrics instead of inventing them. Uses a 2-page layout with the specified section order, accurate dates, metric-first bullets, and delivers a .docx plus a .pdf. Runs the quality checklist.

evals.prompt: can you make my resume ATS friendly? I used a two-column template with a skills sidebar and a header with my contact info.
evals.expected_output: Identifies the ATS risks (columns, sidebar, header content), restructures to a single column with standard bullets, and preserves all of the user's content and dates unchanged.
